src_table_database.query: SELECT dt_database AS 'TableDatabase' ,(case when isnull(dt_schema, '') = '' then '(Blank)' else dt_schema end) as 'SchemaName' ,oo_name AS 'TableName' ,dt_name AS 'Target' ,oo_type_key AS 'TableType' ,op_description AS 'Group' FROM dbo.ws_dbc_target LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_dbc_target.dt_target_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_target_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_obj_pro_map ON dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_pro_map.opm_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_obj_project ON dbo.ws_obj_project.op_project_key = dbo.ws_obj_pro_map.opm_project_key WHERE oo_type_key IN (2,5,6,7,8,9,12,18,21,26,27,28,29,30) --%Table_filter --%Group_filter

src_table_comment.query: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),at_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_agg_tab WHERE at_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),dt_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_dim_tab WHERE dt_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),ft_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_fact_tab WHERE ft_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),lt_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_load_tab WHERE lt_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),nt_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_normal_tab WHERE nt_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),ot_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_ods_tab WHERE ot_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),rt_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_retro_tab WHERE rt_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),st_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_stage_tab WHERE st_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(4000),vt_description) AS 'Description' FROM dbo.ws_view_tab WHERE vt_table_name = 'src_table_name'

src_column_name.query: SELECT ac_col_name AS ColumnName ,ac_display_name AS Lable ,ac_data_type AS DataType ,ac_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN ac_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,ac_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),ac_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,ac_key_type AS ColType ,ac_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_agg_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_agg_col.ac_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT dc_col_name AS ColumnName ,dc_display_name AS Lable ,dc_data_type AS DataType ,dc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN dc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,dc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),dc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,dc_key_type AS ColType ,dc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_dim_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_dim_col.dc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT fc_col_name AS ColumnName ,fc_display_name AS Lable ,fc_data_type AS DataType ,fc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN fc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,fc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),fc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,fc_key_type AS ColType ,fc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_fact_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_fact_col.fc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT lc_col_name AS ColumnName ,lc_display_name AS Lable ,lc_data_type AS DataType ,lc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,NULL AS PKFlag ,lc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),lc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,'Load types' AS ColType ,lc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_load_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_load_col.lc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT nc_col_name AS ColumnName ,nc_display_name AS Lable ,nc_data_type AS DataType ,nc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN nc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,nc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),nc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,nc_key_type AS ColType ,nc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_normal_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_normal_col.nc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT oc_col_name AS ColumnName ,oc_display_name AS Lable ,oc_data_type AS DataType ,oc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN oc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,oc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),oc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,oc_key_type AS ColType ,oc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_ods_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_ods_col.oc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT rc_col_name AS ColumnName ,rc_display_name AS Lable ,rc_data_type AS DataType ,rc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN rc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,rc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),rc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,rc_key_type AS ColType ,rc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_retro_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_retro_col.rc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT sc_col_name AS ColumnName ,sc_display_name AS Lable ,sc_data_type AS DataType ,sc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN sc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,sc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),sc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,sc_key_type AS ColType ,sc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_stage_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_stage_col.sc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT vc_col_name AS ColumnName ,vc_display_name AS Lable ,vc_data_type AS DataType ,vc_default_value AS DefaultValue ,CASE WHEN vc_key_type = 'A' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS PKFlag ,vc_nulls_flag AS Nullable ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(255),vc_src_strategy) AS ColumnComment ,vc_key_type AS ColType ,vc_col_key AS ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_view_col JOIN dbo.ws_obj_object ON dbo.ws_view_col.vc_obj_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name' ORDER BY ColOrder

src_parent_column_name.query: SELECT tj_parent_column AS 'ParentColumn' ,CONCAT(tj_parent_table,'_',tj_child_table) AS 'ConstraintName' ,tj_join_key AS 'Sequence' ,dt_database AS 'TableDatabase' ,(case when isnull(dt_schema, '') = '' then '(Blank)' else dt_schema end) as 'SchemaName' ,tj_child_table AS 'RefTable' ,tj_child_column AS 'RefColumn' FROM dbo.ws_table_joins LEFT JOIN ws_obj_object ON ws_table_joins.tj_parent_obj_key = ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_dbc_target ON dbo.ws_dbc_target.dt_target_key = dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_target_key WHERE tj_parent_table = 'src_table_name'

src_index_name.query: SELECT ih_index_name AS IndexName ,ih_unique AS isUnique ,ih_clustered_ind AS isClustered FROM dbo.ws_index_header WHERE ih_table = 'src_table_name'

src_index_col_name.query: SELECT ic_column AS IndexCol ,ic_column_no as ColOrder FROM dbo.ws_index_col JOIN dbo.ws_index_header ON ic_index_key = ih_index_key WHERE ih_index_name = 'src_index_name'

src_source_set.query: SELECT ISNULL(smt_table_name,'Default Source') AS 'Source set' FROM dbo.ws_obj_object LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_obj_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE dbo.ws_obj_object.oo_name = 'src_table_name'

dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR at_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT smt_parent_obj_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab)) AND at_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND ac_col_name = 'src_column_name' UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(dc_src_table,''),smc_src_table) AS 'Source dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_dim_col.dc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR dt_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT smt_parent_obj_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab)) AND dt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND dc_col_name = 'src_column_name' UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(fc_src_table,''),smc_src_table) AS 'Source entity' ,COALESCE(NULLIF(fc_src_column,''),smc_src_column) AS 'Source dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(nc_src_table,''),smc_src_table) AS 'Source entity' ,COALESCE(NULLIF(nc_src_column,''),smc_src_column) AS 'Source attribute' FROM dbo.ws_normal_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_normal_tab ON dbo.ws_normal_col.nc_obj_key = dbo.ws_normal_tab.nt_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_normal_col.nc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR nt_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_ods_col.oc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR ot_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT smt_parent_obj_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab)) AND ot_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND oc_col_name = 'src_column_name' UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rc_src_table,''),smc_src_table) AS 'Source entity' ,COALESCE(NULLIF(rc_src_column,''),smc_src_column) AS 'Source attribute' FROM dbo.ws_retro_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_retro_tab ON dbo.ws_retro_col.rc_obj_key = dbo.ws_retro_tab.rt_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_retro_col.rc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR rt_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT smt_parent_obj_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab)) AND rt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND rc_col_name = 'src_column_name' UNION SELECT dbo.ws_stage_col.sc_obj_key = dbo.ws_stage_tab.st_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_stage_col.sc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_source_mapping_key WHERE (smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' OR st_obj_key NOT IN(SELECT dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dbo.ws_view_col.vc_col_key = dbo.ws_source_mapping_col.smc_parent_col_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_source_mapping_key = src_dw_query.query: SELECT CONCAT('SELECT ', lt_source_columns, ' FROM ', lt_from_table, ' ', lt_where_clause) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_load_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_dbc_connect ON lt_connect_key = dc_obj_key WHERE dc_type IN ('O','D') AND lt_table_name = 'src_table_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,at_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_agg_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_agg_tab.at_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE at_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,dt_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_dim_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_dim_tab.dt_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE dt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,ft_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_fact_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_fact_tab.ft_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE ft_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,nt_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_normal_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_normal_tab.nt_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE nt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,ot_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_ods_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_ods_tab.ot_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE ot_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,rt_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_retro_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_retro_tab.rt_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE rt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,st_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_stage_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_stage_tab.st_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE st_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(smt_where,vt_where)) AS 'DW Query' FROM dbo.ws_view_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab ON ws_view_tab.vt_obj_key = ws_source_mapping_tab.smt_parent_obj_key WHERE vt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set'

src_transformation_description.query: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),lc_src_strategy) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),lc_transform_model) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_load_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_load_tab ON dbo.ws_load_col.lc_obj_key = dbo.ws_load_tab.lt_obj_key WHERE lt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND lc_col_name = 'src_column_name' UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_src_strategy, ac_src_strategy)) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_transform_model, ac_transform_model)) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_agg_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_agg_tab ON dbo.ws_agg_col.ac_obj_key = dbo.ws_agg_tab.at_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON ac_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT smt_source_mapping_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_agg_tab ON smt_parent_obj_key = at_obj_key WHERE at_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set') OR( ac_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND at_table_name = 'src_table_name') UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_src_strategy, dc_src_strategy)) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_transform_model, dc_transform_model)) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_dim_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_dim_tab ON dbo.ws_dim_col.dc_obj_key = dbo.ws_dim_tab.dt_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON dc_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT smt_source_mapping_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_dim_tab ON smt_parent_obj_key = dt_obj_key WHERE dt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set') OR( dc_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND dt_table_name = 'src_table_name') UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_src_strategy, fc_src_strategy)) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_transform_model, fc_transform_model)) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_fact_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_fact_tab ON dbo.ws_fact_col.fc_obj_key = dbo.ws_fact_tab.ft_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON fc_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT smt_source_mapping_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_fact_tab ON smt_parent_obj_key = ft_obj_key WHERE ft_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set') OR( fc_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND ft_table_name = 'src_table_name') UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_src_strategy, nc_src_strategy)) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_transform_model, nc_transform_model)) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_normal_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_normal_tab ON dbo.ws_normal_col.nc_obj_key = dbo.ws_normal_tab.nt_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON nc_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT smt_source_mapping_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_normal_tab ON smt_parent_obj_key = nt_obj_key WHERE nt_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set') OR( nc_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND nt_table_name = 'src_table_name') UNION SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_src_strategy, oc_src_strategy)) AS 'Description' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(max),ISNULL(smc_transform_model, oc_transform_model)) AS 'Change' FROM dbo.ws_ods_col LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_ods_tab ON dbo.ws_ods_col.oc_obj_key = dbo.ws_ods_tab.ot_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON oc_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT smt_source_mapping_key FROM dbo.ws_source_mapping_tab LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_ods_tab ON smt_parent_obj_key = ot_obj_key WHERE ot_table_name = 'src_table_name' AND smt_table_name = 'src_source_set') OR( oc_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND ot_table_name = 'src_table_name') UNION SELECT dbo.ws_retro_tab ON dbo.ws_retro_col.rc_obj_key = dbo.ws_retro_tab.rt_obj_key LEFT JOIN dbo.ws_source_mapping_col ON rc_col_key = smc_parent_col_key WHERE smc_source_mapping_key IN (SELECT vc_col_name = 'src_column_name' AND vt_table_name = 'src_table_name')
